**Version Info**
- Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge 14.23.5.2859
- Trash Cans, 1.0.17
- Core lib, 1.1.1a for 1.12.2

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
I cannot reproduce the issue with just Trash Cans and its dependencies, so it is likely caused by some other mod you're using. Could you narrow down which other mods are needed to reproduce the issue?

[comment by spiral6 (none)]
I will attempt to narrow it down and test it.

[comment by KingColton1 (none)]
I'm experiencing same issue with this exact crash and error log whenever I click on trash can in my modded server. But it works perfectly fine in single player using same mods my server is using. I don't think it have something to do with other mods, I think it's the server. Maybe the trash can mod is having problem with the server in general?

EDIT: Other players in my server reported that the trash can works just fine in their single player as well, however they also got crashed when right click on trash can in my server.

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
Whoops forget to respond here.
The issue had to do with the dedicated server. Although I wasn't able to reproduce the issue myself, I did end up finding the culprit. It was fixed in version 1.1.3 of my core library.

Thank you all for reporting the issue and sorry for the late response!

[comment by spiral6 (none)]
Apologies for not testing it. Thank you very much for fixing it.

[comment by KingColton1 (none)]
Awesome, thanks!
